Macro.Description: Bench test for a MiniFOC motor driver over CAN (1 Mbit/s classic, 11 bit IDs). Auto test: runs the CAN test sequence and prints PASS / FAIL lines. Only ONE MiniFOC on the bus. Manual current: starts FOC if needed, then sends the entered current every Interval ms until Stop. Switch OFF 'Send always 8 data bytes'. The motor WILL spin: clamp it or lift the wheel.
